hack.root_cause: AMM Liquidity Manipulation (Governance Token Price Pump + Drain)
hack.description: Odin.Fun suffered its third major breach in six months when attackers pumped worthless SATOSHI tokens through its AMM to drain 58.2 BTC ($7M) in real Bitcoin — with treasury insufficient to compensate and trading suspended indefinitely.
